При низком ИМТ приоритетом становится по: When BMI is low, gradually improving energy and nutrient adequacy and tolerating a larger diet take priority.

Малый объём еды: Small meals when appetite is low.
При сниженном аппетите особенно важна пи: With reduced appetite, small portions should provide useful amounts of protein, energy, calcium and key micronutrients.

При риске нарушений пищевого поведения о: When eating-disorder risk is present, automated restriction advice could be harmful. Guidance should support regular and adequate eating rather than increased control.
Не использовать снижение калорийности ка: Do not use calorie reduction as an automatic goal. Assess meal regularity, protein, energy and safety of advice with a qualified clinician.
